subtitle: Every great company has defining moments. These are ours - the milestones that shaped who we are today.

milestones.title: Company Founded
milestones.description: WHITEGUARD was born from a simple but powerful belief: that every organization deserves enterprise-grade cybersecurity. Two founders, one vision — and the relentless drive to make it real.

milestones.title: First 100 Enterprise Clients
milestones.description: A landmark moment — reaching 100 enterprise clients across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Egypt. This milestone proved our unified approach resonated with organizations of every scale and sector.

milestones.title: Launched Unified Security Platform
milestones.description: Introducing White Hawk — our proprietary, AI-driven platform that consolidates threat detection, compliance management, and incident response into a single, intelligent dashboard.

milestones.title: Regional Cybersecurity Excellence Award
milestones.description: Recognized as the leading cybersecurity solutions provider in the MENA region, awarded by the Gulf Technology Council for our outstanding contribution to enterprise security resilience.
